title: German Sausage Skewers
description: A classic German-inspired dish featuring oven-roasted sausage skewers. Perfect for a quick weeknight meal or outdoor gathering.
instructions: Cut sausage into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Cut bell peppers, onions, mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes into bite-sized pieces and thread onto skewers alongside sausage.
Place skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle olive oil over skewers and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Roast in preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until sausage is cooked through.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with roasted garlic if desired.
